scope.finite_stopping_condition: Typed candidate signatures, role distinctions, failure fixtures, and unresolved proof obligations recorded.

provisional_typed_model.Aspect: A[C, P*] where C is an explicit computational or analysis context and P* is a finite primitive organization
provisional_typed_model.continuation_candidate: Only RT_C may enter the post-closure calculation relation unless a separately typed projection is defined.

findings.title: MTO requires an explicit admissibility domain
findings.statement: The proposal requires a lawful subset of aspect organizations before MTO can be typed as a total or deterministic construction.

findings.title: Aspect has two proposed roles that must be context-indexed
findings.statement: An expression such as 2+2 may be a computational aspect during MTO and an analysis condition when used as an observed relational object; the roles cannot be collapsed without a context or role tag.

findings.title: OTM output should preserve primitive multiplicity if multiplicity matters
findings.statement: The source says OTM returns a Primitive Set, but a set may erase repeated primitive occurrence. A multiset or structured primitive decomposition is therefore a safer candidate until multiplicity irrelevance is established.
required_evidence: proof that set projection is lossless if retained

findings.title: MTO-output equivalence is conditional, not established
findings.statement: The proposed relation A1 equivalent A2 iff MTO(A1)=MTO(A2) is admissible only after RT output identity/equivalence and deterministic MTO selection are independently defined.
findings.nonclaim: Equal observed arithmetic values alone do not establish aspect equivalence.

findings.title: Orientation resolution needs a deterministic selector
findings.statement: An orientation field cannot resolve to one RT until comparison, admissibility, tie-breaking, and failure behavior are specified.

positive.case: A[computational, 2+2] is admissible in a declared MTO context
A[analysis, 2+2] is admissible as an observed condition in a declared analysis context
OTM(R) returns primitive decomposition without historical aspect reconstruction
positive.expected: primitive multiset or explicitly lossless primitive structure

rejection.case: Use one untyped Aspect object interchangeably in computational and analysis roles
Infer A1 equivalent A2 from equal arithmetic output without deterministic MTO and RT identity
Use an unordered Primitive Set where repeated primitive occurrence affects later MTO
Resolve an orientation field by implementation order

open_obligations: Define context-indexed Aspect roles and legal role transitions.
Define RT identity/equivalence separately from aspect equivalence.
Prove or test deterministic MTO output selection.
Define OTM decomposition carrier and multiplicity semantics.
Define orientation comparison, tie-breaking, and failure semantics.
Specify whether post-closure calculation accepts only RT or also governed RT projections.

assessment.reason: The proposal can be given a bounded typed candidate model and concrete rejection fixtures, but its equivalence, totality, determinism, and decomposition claims remain unresolved.
assessment.recommended_next_action: Create an independent finite fixture evaluator for role-indexed aspects, deterministic MTO candidates, and OTM multiplicity preservation.

termination_reason: Finite formalization scope completed; further progress requires executable fixtures or authorized mathematical definitions.
what_this_does_not_authorize: treating Aspect as unconditionally transient or persistent across all contexts
treating equal MTO outputs as established mathematical equivalence
